title: BICEP2 primordial gravitational waves: foreground dust narrows an extraordinary CMB claim
summary: A physical-science correction record for BICEP2. Encodes the movement from an extraordinary B-mode/inflationary-gravitational-wave interpretation to a joint Planck/BICEP/Keck foreground-dust correction and bounded nonconfirmation, without declaring inflation false.

status_history.note: Seed flagged BICEP2 primordial gravitational waves / dust as a case worth cataloging.
Promoted in rev0021 physical-science anomaly/correction lane.

place.scope: South Pole BICEP2 CMB observation and Planck/BICEP/Keck joint foreground analysis context

subjects.name: Planck, BICEP2, and Keck Array analysis

claims.claim: The initial BICEP2 evidence surface reported excess B-mode power, an r estimate near 0.20, and strong significance while explicitly warning that available dust models were not sufficiently constrained and foreground dust could shift the value downward.
what_would_change_status: A correction changes the r/excess/dust-caveat description of the initial BICEP2 evidence surface.

claims.claim: ESA’s joint Planck/BICEP2/Keck analysis page says there was no conclusive evidence for primordial gravitational waves; once galactic dust was better separated with multi-frequency information, the earlier detection was no longer robust.
what_would_change_status: A later joint-analysis source recharacterizes the 2015 Planck/BICEP/Keck dust-correction status.

claims.claim: The same joint-analysis source preserves boundary language: inflation is not ruled out, an upper limit is established, and a primordial signal could still be present below the then-current sensitivity.
what_would_change_status: A later consensus review shows this boundary caution is obsolete or materially incomplete.

limitations: Does not extract the full joint paper mathematics or Planck likelihoods.
Does not build a timeline of press coverage or public misunderstanding.

type_payload.hypothesis_or_claim_tested: The BICEP2 B-mode signal was a robust detection of primordial gravitational waves from inflation rather than foreground dust/foreground-model ambiguity.
type_payload.prior_evidentiary_route: Single-frequency BICEP2 observation with strong apparent excess, followed by Planck multi-frequency dust information and joint analysis.
scope_cautions: Does not say inflation is false.
Does not say BICEP2 data were worthless.
Distinguishes foreground-model correction from fraud or fabrication.

handling_notes: Avoid caricaturing the initial claim; preserve the explicit foreground caveat.
Preserve the distinction between narrowing a claim and erasing a research program.

unknowns: Full joint Planck/BICEP/Keck PRL extraction remains open.
next_actions: Add the joint PRL paper as a primary-paper record when locator depth is increased.
Add a public-communication timeline only if source quality supports it.
Use as a foreground/control-model exemplar for anomaly-discipline pattern testing.
